title: ADATA posts record 3Q revenue as memory prices rise
content: ADATA Technology reported record consolidated revenue of NT$53.03 billion(NT$53.03 billion)in the third quarter of 2026, topping NT$50 billion for the period as tighter memory supply and higher prices lifted sales. The memory module maker also said September consolidated revenue reached NT$15.73 billion, up 200% year-over-year but down 16.9% from August after it strategically adjusted shipments.

title: LG lands 5GW North American data center cooling deal
content: LG Electronics has signed a long-term agreement to supply chillers for data center projects totaling more than 5GW of capacity in the US and Canada, giving the South Korean company greater visibility into future demand as it expands its North American cooling business.

title: Chinese LCD panel makers tighten supply to lift prices — Taiwan suppliers eye order shifts
content: Chinese panel makers moved to cut production during the National Day holiday after issuing their first price increase notices in September, combining pricing signals with supply controls to stabilize LCD TV panel prices and profitability.

title: China's 15th five-year plan elevates PCB role in AI supply chains
content: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the National Development and Reform Commission have released the 15th Five-Year Plan for the development of the electronic information manufacturing industry, aiming to push revenue at large-scale enterprises above CNY30 trillion (US$4.5 trillion) by 2030 and foster world-class companies in semiconductors, advanced computing, consumer electronics, basic electronics, and energy electronics.

title: Samsung secures customer backing for US$5B substrate expansion
content: Samsung Electro-Mechanics is investing KRW6.78 trillion (approx. US$5 billion) to expand FCBGA capacity in South Korea and Vietnam. The projects are backed by customer funding and medium- to long-term volume commitments, as demand for high-performance package substrates pushes Korean production lines toward high utilization.

title: Drone share tops 10% as Calin Technology eyes LEO optics, auto growth
content: Optical lens maker Calin Technology is seeing its new business ventures bear fruit. Revenue from its drone camera module segment has surpassed 10% of total sales in 2026 and is targeting over 15%, making it the company's fastest-growing product line this year. Meanwhile, automotive lens revenue is projected to remain flat in 2026 before returning to growth in 2027, driven by a new design-in project with a US automaker.

title: Arcadyan September revenue hits record on mobile communications strength
content: As the networking market enters its traditional peak season, customer demand is gradually recovering. Arcadyan Technology announced on October 5 its September revenue, which reached NT$5.06 billion (approx. US$159.3 million), up 7.0% month-over-month and 8.5% year-over-year. This marked a record high.
